name: Emmanuel Konan
headline: Cybersecurity Engineer
summary: Cybersecurity consultant specialized in IT, OT and IoT security, with experience in risk analysis, security audits, industrial systems and embedded security. I have worked across the energy, financial, public and IT/software sectors, combining technical expertise with cybersecurity governance and risk management.

experience.summary: Cybersecurity consultant working across public/administrative organizations, financial institutions, energy companies and IT/software companies, covering risk management, technical audits, industrial cybersecurity and compliance.
bullets: Lead EBIOS-RM risk analyses and facilitate workshops with business and technical stakeholders.
Perform PASSI security audits covering architecture, configuration, source code, organizational and physical security.
Conduct internal ISO/IEC 27001 audits, assessing controls, governance and ISMS effectiveness.
Support clients on regulatory compliance, running NIS2 gap analyses and remediation roadmaps, and assessing AI Act obligations for AI-enabled systems.
Define security requirements and conduct qualification and audits of industrial, embedded and connected equipment.
Act as cybersecurity referent for OT/IoT equipment at Enedis, advising on PKI/HSM, PKCS#11, cryptographic mechanisms and asset mapping.
Participate in the preparation and facilitation of cybersecurity crisis exercises, testing incident response, coordination and decision-making.
Design and deliver cybersecurity training to client companies, covering technical, governance and awareness topics for both expert and non-expert audiences.
Deliver cybersecurity engagements across administrative, financial, energy and IT/software environments.
Integration of post-quantum cryptography (PQC) algorithms into environments with limited compute and storage resources.
Led the firm's AI adoption initiative, identifying use cases and supporting secure integration into consulting workflows.

experience.summary: Worked within a multidisciplinary team of cybersecurity experts on the security of embedded systems, smart metering and critical infrastructure.
bullets: Assessed security risks and threat models related to security modules embedded in industrial systems.
Analyzed defense-in-depth architectures, hardware security (CPU, memory, buses) and potential vulnerabilities.
Conducted research on cryptographic mechanisms, SSH protocols (RFC 4250-4254), PLC and ISO/IEC 7816 smart-card standards.
Performed vulnerability research and penetration-testing activities on embedded environments.
Modified the OpenSSH client in C for custom security testing and information gathering.
Developed Python and Bash scripts to automate security testing and analysis.

experience.summary: Worked within Enedis' B2B division on initiatives aimed at reducing non-technical losses and electricity fraud, combining data analysis, project management and operational coordination.
bullets: Performed data mining and consumption analysis to identify potential fraud and abnormal electricity usage.
Automated monthly reporting and KPIs using VBA, improving performance monitoring.
Managed a national project introducing a new feature within the electricity distribution network.
Conducted security and compliance assessments of internal business tools.
Supported the development of Enedis' B2B strategic plan and internal awareness initiatives.
Completed a field immersion with operational technicians, gaining practical knowledge of electricity distribution, non-technical losses and the French energy market.
